plan.notes: Source is AUM's institution-published '4-Year Plan' for Sport Management (file dated 2-3-23 via URL, currently published on aum.edu) — a sample term-by-term schedule including Summer semesters, seeded per the sample-schedule rule. Flight plan header reads 'Major: Kinesiology Degree: Sport Management'. Generic slots (MATH, FINE ARTS, HISTORY, ENGL (LITERATURE COURSE), HIST or ENGL LIT CORE, Natural Science Core/Lab, Area II or Area IV Elective, PHED Activity Course, PHED Elective, PHED Theory & Tech., Sport Management Elective) are choice:true with the flight plan's own wording; specific courses are not assigned by the source. '3|1' lecture|lab pairs (e.g., BIOL 1000/1001) are seeded as a single slot at the combined credit total. Course titles for coded courses are from the official AUM 2023-2024 Undergraduate Catalog course descriptions. The flight plan does not list prerequisites, so no prereq chains are seeded. Credit-sum note: the plan as published sums to 123 credits (16+14+14+16+6+15+15+3+15+9); no degree total is stated on the flight plan. total_credits is the true sum 123. The catalog lists PHED 4934 Internship in Sport Management as (9) but the flight plan assigns 6 credits; the flight plan's 6 is transcribed verbatim.
